notes:
Describes something that conforms to the norm or average for a given group. Often used in discussions of statistics, demographics, and general comparisons. Can carry a neutral or slightly negative nuance when implying mediocrity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平均的|へいきんてき}な{日本人|にほんじん}: average Japanese person
- {平均的|へいきんてき}な{収入|しゅうにゅう}: average income
- {平均的|へいきんてき}な{体格|たいかく}: average build
- {平均的|へいきんてき}な{生活|せいかつ}: average lifestyle
- {平均的|へいきんてき}に{見|み}て: on average, looking at it from an average standpoint

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {普通|ふつう}: normal, ordinary — more colloquial and subjective; describes what is considered standard
- {標準的|ひょうじゅんてき}: standard, typical — implies conformity to an established norm or benchmark
- {一般的|いっぱんてき}: general, common — describes what is widely shared or applicable

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of {平均|へいきん} (average, mean) + {的|てき} (adjectival suffix).

definitions.explanation: representative of a statistical or general average; typical of a group or category; neither exceptionally good nor bad

examples.japanese: {平均的|へいきんてき}な{日本人|にほんじん}の{食事|しょくじ}。
examples.english: The diet of an average Japanese person.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}の{気温|きおん}は{平均的|へいきんてき}だ。
examples.english: The temperature in this area is average.

examples.japanese: {平均的|へいきんてき}な{会社員|かいしゃいん}の{年収|ねんしゅう}は{約|やく}400{万円|まんえん}だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that the average office worker's annual income is about four million yen.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{成績|せいせき}は{平均的|へいきんてき}で、{特|とく}に{目立|めだ}つところはない。
examples.english: His grades are average, and nothing stands out in particular.
